text: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining. Today I want to go through the spring catalogue launch and the open issues with the webshop.
Thanks. From the marketing side we are mostly ready. The campaign assets are approved, but we are still waiting for the final product photos from the studio.
On the webshop, the new checkout flow is deployed to the test environment. We found two bugs with the discount codes, and I expect them to be fixed by Thursday.
Okay, so the photos and the discount bug are the two blockers. Zira, can you chase the studio today and give us a date?
Yes, I will call them after this meeting and send an update in the channel before lunch.
Hej allesammen. Jeg har et spørgsmål om lageret. Har vi nok varer i Aarhus til lanceringen, eller skal vi flytte noget fra Odense?
I checked the stock report yesterday. Aarhus has enough for the first two weeks, but the ceramic bowls are low everywhere.
Good point. Let us order more ceramic bowls this week. David, please send me the numbers and I will place the order on Friday.
Det lyder godt. Jeg giver butikkerne besked om, at der kommer flere skåle i næste uge.
One more thing: the newsletter goes out on Monday, so every page has to be live by Sunday evening at the latest.
Agreed. Let us meet again on Thursday to check status. Thanks everyone, have a great day.
